description: Close R1/C1 and R2 in the Razorpay webhook: paid-but-blocked commerce outcomes must NEVER fall through to the legacy invoice path, and the legacy invoice settlement must enforce payment-to-invoice binding plus a unique one-time claim so one captured payment cannot settle two unrelated invoices and a replay with the same payment_id under a different referenceId cannot double-settle. All financial decisions remain gated on an authoritative provider readback, never the event body. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: R1/C1 — In amplify/functions/payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py, _handle_payment_captured (around line 940-967): the current guard branches to _verified_legacy_invoice whenever `not verified_paid`, which incorrectly includes every PAID_BUT_BLOCKED outcome. Change the control flow to consult outcome['outcome']: import order_creation and permit the legacy path ONLY when the outcome is order_creation.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE (positively-established legacy-only provenance: no PaymentAttempt exists). For ANY outcome in order_creation.PAID_BUT_BLOCKED_OUTCOMES (AMOUNT_MISMATCH, CURRENCY_MISMATCH, CUSTOMER_MISMATCH, IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE, PROVIDER_PAYMENT_CONFLICT), and for every other rejected/conflicting/unresolved outcome (NOT_PAID, ATTEMPT_NOT_PAYABLE, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, NO_PROVIDER_ID, RECONCILIATION_ERROR, NEEDS_RECONCILIATION), route straight to _quarantine_unverified_capture — never to the legacy verifier and never to any invoice-paid / post-payment / confirmation side effect.
Preserve the existing behaviour for ORDER_CREATED / ORDER_ALREADY_EXISTS (has_order True) unchanged — those remain the authoritative verified-paid success path.

R2 (binding) — In _verified_legacy_invoice (around line 575-668): the invoice total+currency+captured check is necessary but not sufficient. Additionally require a stored provider-order/account/payment-to-invoice binding on the matched invoice row: the invoice (or an associated reference row) must carry a provider identifier (providerOrderId / providerPaymentId / order_id) and the capture's provider order id must match it. If the invoice row carries NO provider binding at all, the legacy path cannot positively establish that THIS payment settles THIS invoice — refuse (return False → quarantine) rather than matching on amount equality alone. Use the authoritative razorpay_verify readback (not the event body) for the payment's provider order id/account. Document the exact binding fields consulted in the docstring.

R2 (one-time claim) — Before any invoice write on the legacy path, claim a conditional PROVIDERPAYMENT#<payment_id> marker (reuse the order_keys._claim_row conditional-write primitive / claim_order_for_payment pattern on the commerce-keys table) so a given payment_id can settle at most one invoice. If the claim is lost (already claimed for a different reference/invoice), do NOT settle — route to quarantine. This defeats the replay-across-references double-settle: a second signature-valid event carrying the same payment_id under a different referenceId finds the claim already held and settles nothing.

R2 (single-row conditional settlement) — Replace the loop-over-all-matching-rows in _mark_invoice_paid_by_reference (around line 1588) so it settles exactly ONE invoice row conditionally (ConditionExpression binding the write to not-already-paid AND to the claimed payment id), not every GSI match. If the GSI returns more than one matching invoice for the reference, treat it as ambiguous: settle none and quarantine for a human, mirroring the single-match discipline already used by the sibling _mark_invoice_paid_by_phone_and_amount.

Keep all logging type-only / correlation-id only; never log the event body, amounts-as-free-text, contact, notes, or any secret. Never raise out of the webhook (a non-2xx triggers a full Razorpay retry); on any error route to quarantine.

Add regression tests in tests/ (extend tests/test_razorpay_webhook_captured_gating.py and tests/test_payment_reconciliation_safety.py, or add a new tests/test_legacy_invoice_settlement_safety.py) that drive the REAL _handle_payment_captured / _verified_legacy_invoice against the existing in-memory DynamoDB fake with a stubbed razorpay_verify. Required cases, each asserting NO invoice-paid / NO post-payment side effect occurs on the blocked paths: (a) a paid-but-blocked outcome (e.g. CUSTOMER_MISMATCH and PROVIDER_PAYMENT_CONFLICT) arriving at a referenceId that DOES have an invoice row must quarantine, NOT settle; (b) one captured payment whose amount matches two unrelated invoices settles at most one (ambiguous → none) and never both; (c) a second signature-valid event with the SAME payment_id but a DIFFERENT referenceId does NOT double-settle (the PROVIDERPAYMENT# claim blocks it); (d) a genuine UNKNOWN_REFERENCE legacy invoice with a matching provider binding and provider-verified capture DOES settle exactly once (positive path preserved). Tests must fail if the fix is reverted.
acceptance_criteria: _handle_payment_captured routes every member of order_creation.PAID_BUT_BLOCKED_OUTCOMES and every rejected/conflicting/unresolved outcome to _quarantine_unverified_capture, and permits _verified_legacy_invoice ONLY on order_creation.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE
_verified_legacy_invoice refuses to settle when the invoice carries no provider binding, and requires the provider-verified capture's provider order id/account to match the stored binding
A conditional PROVIDERPAYMENT#<payment_id> claim is made before any legacy invoice write; a replayed same-payment_id/different-referenceId event settles nothing
_mark_invoice_paid_by_reference settles exactly one row conditionally (or none when ambiguous), never a loop over all matches
New tests drive the real handler against the DynamoDB fake and cover cases (a)-(d) above; they fail if the fix is reverted
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q passes with no regressions (count >= 5717 passed plus the new tests)
findings:
Implemented R1/C1 and R2 in amplify/functions/payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py.

R1/C1 (_handle_payment_captured): the legacy fall-through now consults the typed outcome. It imports order_creation and permits _verified_legacy_invoice ONLY when outcome['outcome'] == order_creation.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE. Every PAID_BUT_BLOCKED outcome (AMOUNT_MISMATCH, CURRENCY_MISMATCH, CUSTOMER_MISMATCH, IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE, PROVIDER_PAYMENT_CONFLICT) and every other rejected/unresolved outcome now routes straight to _quarantine_unverified_capture. ORDER_CREATED/ORDER_ALREADY_EXISTS (hasOrder True) success path unchanged.

R2 binding (_verified_legacy_invoice): now requires exactly one invoice row for the reference (ambiguous->refuse), a stored provider binding on the invoice (providerOrderId / order_id / providerPaymentId - documented in the docstring), and an authoritative provider readback via the NEW razorpay_verify.payment_capture_details(payment_id) -> (captured, amount_paise, currency, provider_order_id). The capture's provider order id (from the readback, never the event body) must match the invoice's binding, or the verified payment id must equal the invoice's bound providerPaymentId; an unbound invoice is refused. Amount/currency still checked to the paise.

R2 one-time claim: added order_keys.claim_legacy_invoice_payment(), a conditional PROVIDERPAYMENT#<payment_id> _claim_row sharing the namespace with claim_order_for_payment, claimed BEFORE any invoice write. A lost claim (replay with same payment_id under a different referenceId, or a payment already claimed by the commerce path) returns False -> quarantine, settling nothing.

R2 single-row settlement (_mark_invoice_paid_by_reference): replaced the loop-over-all-GSI-matches with: >1 match -> ambiguous -> settle none + quarantine; exactly one -> conditional update bound to status<>'paid' (so a concurrent/replayed delivery is a harmless no-op); stamps providerPaymentId when supplied. The success caller now passes payment_id.

All logging stays type-only/correlation-id only; the webhook never raises (errors route to quarantine).

Tests: added tests/test_legacy_invoice_settlement_safety.py (9 cases a-d driving the REAL handler against FakeDynamo with a stubbed payment_capture_details/verifier). Updated tests/test_razorpay_webhook_captured_gating.py legacy cases to seed a provider binding and stub payment_capture_details. Taught tests/crm_fake_dynamo.py the `<>` inequality condition form (used by the single-row conditional settlement). Verified both reverts fail: reverting the R1/C1 guard fails the three paid-but-blocked tests; neutralising the claim fails the replay test.

Evidence: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q => 5727 passed, 1 skipped (baseline was 5717 passed, 1 skipped; +10 new tests, no regressions). Targeted suites (captured_gating, payment_reconciliation_safety, quarantine_recovery, razorpay_binding, legacy_invoice_settlement_safety) => 73 passed. No AWS/network calls made (razorpay_verify stubbed in tests). No frontend/TS files touched.
